```{r setup, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(Rcpp)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#sourceCpp("spacetime.cpp")
source("pltfuns.R")

# One horizontal color bar for each assembled contour figure.
contour_legend = list(
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(
    direction = "horizontal",
    theme = theme(
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(14, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.45, "cm")
    )
  )),
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
)

```


# Contour plot for F-LMatern
```{r}
s = seq(-4, 4, length.out=100) # space 
t = seq(-4, 4, length.out=100) # time
df = expand_grid(s=s, t=t)
input = as.matrix(df)
n = nrow(input)
# setup parameters
sig2 = 1
tail = c(.5, .8)
range = .4
nu = 0.5
rho = .2
nugget = 0.00
matern.df = df 

matern.df$f1 = STVGP::stgp.cor(
  input, matrix(0, ncol=2), covfun_name="LFMatern",
  cov.par=list(nu=nu, range=range, rho=rho))

matern.f1 = plt_contour(df=data.frame(s=matern.df$s,
                          t=matern.df$t,
                          cor=matern.df$f1)
                        )
#matern.f1 

```

### Assemble all the plots for LMatern
```{r, fig.height=9, fig.width=16}
library(latex2exp)
library(patchwork)

df1 = matern.df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols=c(f1,z1,z2,f3,z5,z6,f2,z3,z4),
    names_to="group", values_to="cor") %>%
  mutate(group = 
           factor(group,
           levels=c("f1", "z1", "z2", 
                    "f3", "z5", "z6",
                    "f2", "z3", "z4"),               
           ordered=TRUE))

xlims = c(-3,3)
ylims = c(3,3)

labs1 = c(
  f1="ϕ=0.4, v=0.2",
  z1="λ=0.2, Λ=1",
  z2="λ=0.2, Λ=4",
  f3="ϕ=0.8, v=0",
  z5="λ=0, Λ=1",
  z6="λ=0, Λ=4",
  f2="ϕ=0.8, v=-1",
  z3="λ=-1, Λ=1",
  z4="λ=-1, Λ=4")


gg1 = plt2_contour(df=df1, 
                   subtitle=labs1,
                   xlab="u", ylab="h",
                   n_col=3) + contour_legend
print(gg1)
ggsave("./figures/contour_LMatern.png", width=16, height=10)

```


## LCH model

# Contour plot for Frozen CH model 
```{r}
s = seq(-4, 4, length.out=100) # space 
t = seq(-4, 4, length.out=100) # time
df = expand_grid(s=s, t=t)
input = as.matrix(df)
n = nrow(input)
# setup parameters
sig2 = 1
tail = .2
range = .4
nu = 0.5
rho = .2 
nugget = 0.00
Lam = matrix(1,1,1)

ch.df = df
ch.df$f1 = STVGP::stgp.cor(
  input, matrix(0, ncol=2), covfun_name="LFCH",
  cov.par=list(nu=nu, range=range, tail=tail, rho=rho))


ch.f1 = plt_contour(df=data.frame(s=ch.df$s,
                          t=ch.df$t,
                          cor=ch.df$f1))

#ch.f1
```

### Assemble all the plots for LCH
```{r,fig.height=9, fig.width=16}
library(latex2exp)
library(patchwork)

df2 = ch.df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols=c(f1,z1,z2,f3,z5,z6, f2,z3,z4),
    names_to="group", values_to="cor") %>%
  mutate(group = 
           factor(group,
           levels=c("f1", "z1", "z2", 
                    "f3", "z5", "z6",
                    "f2", "z3", "z4"),               
           ordered=TRUE))

xlims = c(-3,3)
ylims = c(3, 3)

labs2 = c(
  "f1"="α=0.2, β=0.4, v=0.2",
  "z1"="λ=0.2, Λ=1",
  "z2"="λ=0.2, Λ=4",
  "f3"="α=0.2, β=0.8, v=0",
  "z5"="λ=0, Λ=1",
  "z6"="λ=0, Λ=4",
  "f2"="α=0.2, β=0.8, v=-1",
  "z3"="λ=-1, Λ=1",
  "z4"="λ=-1, Λ=4"
  )



gg2 = plt2_contour(df=df2, 
                   subtitle=labs2, 
                   xlab="u", ylab="h",
                   n_col=3) + contour_legend
print(gg2)
ggsave("./figures/contour_LCH.png", width=16, height=12)

```

## Generalized models

The generalized parameter `a` is greater than the spatial dimension
$d=1$ in all panels. The CH tail parameter is unchanged.




### Contour plot for GLMatern model
```{r}
s = seq(-4, 4, length.out=100) # space 
t = seq(-4, 4, length.out=100) # time
df = expand_grid(s=s, t=t)
input = as.matrix(df)
n = nrow(input)
# setup parameters
sig2 = 1
tail = c(.5, .8)
range = .4
nu = 0.5
rho = .2
nugget = 0.00
Lam = matrix(1,1,1)
a=1.5

GL.df = data.frame(df)
GL.df$z1 = STVGP::stgp.cor(
  input, matrix(0, ncol=2), covfun_name="GLMatern",
  cov.par=list(nu=nu, range=range, rho=rho, Lam=Lam, a=a))

GL.g1 = plt_contour(df=data.frame(s=GL.df$s,
                          t=GL.df$t,
                          cor=GL.df$z1)
                        )
#GL.g1


```

### Assemble all the plots for generalized Matern/LCH models 
```{r,fig.height=9, fig.width=16}
library(latex2exp)
library(patchwork)

df3 = GL.df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols=c(z1,z2,z3, z4, z5,z6),
    names_to="group", values_to="cor") %>%
  mutate(group = 
           factor(group,
           levels=c( "z1", "z2", 
                    "z3", "z4", "z5", "z6"),               
           ordered=TRUE))

xlims = c(-3,3)
ylims = c(3, 3)

# Render Greek symbols as mathematical expressions, avoiding encoding issues.
labs2 = c(
  z1 = "list(phi == 0.4, a == 1.5)",
  z2 = "list(phi == 0.4, a == '2.0')",
  z3 = "list(phi == 0.4, a == '3.0')",
  z4 = "list(alpha == 0.3, beta == 0.8, a == 1.5)",
  z5 = "list(alpha == 0.3, beta == 0.8, a == '2.0')",
  z6 = "list(alpha == 0.3, beta == 0.8, a == '3.0')"
)



gg3 = plt2_contour(df=df3, 
                   subtitle=as_labeller(labs2, default=label_parsed), 
                   xlab="u", ylab="h",
                   n_col=3) + contour_legend
print(gg3)
ggsave("./figures/contour_GLM_GLCH.png", width=16, height=12)

```
